Audit.dc.html.title: Audit of the SIFT 2.0 phone build

t-phones.text: SIFT, a sports companion with the models running quietly

n-home.text: Home. Live games first, then upcoming by time. Teams you follow sit on top, a week of days sits below, and a signal chip appears only on rows that have one. Scores, clocks and plays are design samples, labelled Sample. Open Tweaks to switch the feed.

n-hpub.text: The same Home with the data SIFT has today: start times and an In play label, no scores. This is the state to ship until a live feed exists.

n-game.text: Game. Four tabs: Live, Matchups, Players, Markets. Swipe between them, tap the signal row for its sheet, tap a player for the ladder. After kickoff the research is frozen and says so.

n-sig.text: Signals. The full list of research candidates. Tap a row for the sheet, tap or drag its handle between half and full.

t-why.text: What is missing, what was found, and the language it is built in
